extracted.name: Watermelon & lychee pitcher
extracted.description: Use non-alcoholic sparkling wine to keep this watermelon and lychee mocktail feeling grown-up. It's ideal for designated drivers at a summer party
ingredient_lines: 1 kg watermelon (prepared weight), cut into cubes
90ml fresh lime juice plus lime slices to serve
non-alcoholic sparkling wine for topping up
instruction_lines: Blitz the prepared watermelon in a blender until smooth.
Tip some ice, the lime juice, lime slices, lychee syrup and puréed watermelon into a large pitcher, and stir well. Top up with non-alcoholic sparkling wine and stir.
